name: a standing spelled with a capital
why: The same list, in another letter case: "Hit" is not "hit". The generator will match the word the list names, so a capital would reach the page as a measure the renderer cannot judge -- and the snapshot test refuses it as surely as a word off the list.
fails: measures[0].standing is not one of hit, pending, miss
